annotations.title: Score Bid/No-Bid Pwin & Match Capability Statement

description: Evaluate an RFP scope against a vendor's Capability Statement and past performance to compute a 0-100 Probability of Win (Pwin) score, a Gate-1 Bid/No-Bid recommendation, a technical/socioeconomic gap analysis, and a tailored executive pitch. This is a read-only, stateless capture scoring call (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; both `rfp_text` and `company_capability_statement` are required, while `target_pursuit_role` weights eligibility rules for 'prime_contractor', 'subcontractor_or_jv', or 'either_prime_or_sub' [default]). Use this tool when conducting Gate-1 capture qualification to decide whether to bid an opportunity; use `generate_teaming_strategy` instead if you already decided to bid and need a 13 CFR 125.6 (50% Rule) Prime/Sub workshare plan, or `match_key_personnel` to evaluate individual candidate resumes.

company_capability_statement.description: Vendor capability statement including core competencies, socioeconomic certifications (8(a), SDVOSB, WOSB, HUBZone), facility clearances, and past performance summary.

rfp_text.description: Target solicitation scope, mandatory technical qualifications, NAICS/set-aside designation, clearance requirements, and Section M evaluation criteria.

target_pursuit_role.description: Preferred pursuit posture to evaluate: 'prime_contractor', 'subcontractor_or_jv', or 'either_prime_or_sub'.

name: match_capability_statement

bid_recommendation.description: Executive gate decision: STRONG_BID, CONDITIONAL_BID_TEAMING_REQUIRED, HIGH_RISK_STRETCH_BID, or NO_BID.

hard_disqualifiers_detected.description: Mandatory knockout blockers detected (e.g., missing Top Secret FCL, ineligible socioeconomic status, missing required contract vehicle).

key_discriminators.description: High-impact competitive strengths from the vendor profile to highlight as Shipley win themes.

pwin_score.description: Estimated Probability of Win (Pwin) score from 0 (disqualified / no fit) to 100 (ideal prime fit).

recommended_pursuit_role.description: Optimal pursuit structure (e.g., 'Prime Contractor', 'Prime with Teaming Subcontractor for Top Secret FCL', 'Subcontractor to Large Prime').

requirement_gap_analysis.description: Requirement-by-requirement alignment matrix with matched vendor evidence and gap remediation actions.

score_breakdown.description: Granular 0-100 scoring across technical fit, past performance, clearances/certifications, and set-aside/vehicle eligibility.

solicitation_title.description: Identified or inferred title and agency of the solicitation.

tailored_executive_summary_pitch.description: Ready-to-paste, persuasive Shipley Executive Summary / Sources Sought pitch paragraph tailored to the buyer agency using the vendor's exact past performance.

teaming_and_subcontracting_strategy.description: Concrete recommendation on how to structure the capture team, JV, or subcontractor roster to maximize Pwin.

title: Score Bid/No-Bid Pwin & Match Capability Statement
